reason: In a normal week I'm not paying ahead of time for an exam cram pass because I never start studying until 48 hours before a midterm. When panic actually hits, I already dump my slides into free AI tools and grab past-exam PDFs from upperclassmen on Zalo instead of spending 49,000 VND on a new app.
objection: Even with an untimed toggle, the whole Clutch Arena sprint-timer and live-room vibe feels stressful and overcomplicated when I'm tired at midnight and just want fast answers—plus I doubt it handles messy mixed English-Vietnamese lecture slides better than free ChatGPT well enough to justify paying.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing a classmate in my Zalo study group prove the free preview actually nails our specific messy English-Vietnamese past-exam PDF right before a midterm with zero broken formulas.
